title: Revin vs. Hatch: which is better?
summary: Leaping AI is a great alternative to both Revin and Hatch
body_markdown:
Revin and Hatch are two conversational AI companies in the home improvement space. Hatch has been an established players since before 2020 and was recently acquired by Yelp. It started as a texting AI platform for nurturing leads and recently expanded to voice AI. Revin also started as a SMS AI platform and recently expanded to voice AI.


### Hatch has been around for longer


Hatch's biggest pro is that is has been around longer and has a wide variety of partnerships, e.g. with Yelp. It also recently started using state of the art LLM models, such as GPT Live from OpenAI.


The texting platform is probably the most mature out of all solutions.


### Alternative: Leaping AI


While both companies started as texting AI companies, Leaping AI has always been voice AI first. We continuously see voice AI outperforming texting AI from an appointments booked perspective. At the same time, Leaping AI bundles voice AI and texting AI features in one platform.


Key differentiators for Leaping AI are:


1.


Powerful campaign orchestration features: voice AI agents and texting AI agents work side by side to attempt to get an appointment booked. Up to 100 reach outs in the first 30 days of a lead coming in and 15 second speed to lead.


2.


In-built number scrubbing and number health monitoring feature. Especially for outbound dialing, maintaining good number health is of the utmost importance. Furthermore, we maintain an in-house DNC database, so that homeowners who opted out, will not be reached out to again.


3.


Over 100 different languages. Next to English, we commonly help our customers implement multi-lingual agents in Spanish, French Canadian, etc.


For companies evaluating Hatch vs. Revin, Leaping AI presents a great alternative.
